concerns.text: The plan schedules 30 seeds × 5 conditions (150 total runs) with each CI job limited to ≤6 h and ≤7 GB RAM. Running 30 independent TinyLlama‑1.1B training runs (even with 4‑bit CPU quantization) on a free‑tier GitHub Actions runner is unlikely to complete within the 6‑hour wall‑clock limit, making the compute feasibility assumption unrealistic. Adjust the design to reduce the number of seeds per job, shorten training epochs, or use a smaller model to stay within free‑tier constraints.
